Beijing is on high alert after another devastating vehicle attack left dozens dead and injured. Survivors have come forward to recount the horrifying moment. Why did the driver choose the most crowded time to carry out the attack? And what story of injustice and suffering lies buried within the thick stack of petition documents found in his vehicle?
